scientific_role: definition amendment and operator-unit verification only

versioning.unresolved_factor_action: FACTOR_DEFINITION_UNRESOLVED and lower readiness; never silently delete a factor

membership_derivation.state_source: frozen V3 reference candidate MYOLEG_V3_K0312, beta=[0,0], 401 states
membership_derivation.mechanical_quantity: actuator moment matrix projected through the independent-coordinate tangent; positive actuator force generalized effect in project q_hip/q_knee flexion coordinates
membership_derivation.near_zero_states: excluded from sign denominator when abs(target moment arm) < 1e-5 m
membership_derivation.monoarticular_rule: target effective-state fraction >=0.8 and other-joint maximum absolute projected moment arm <=1e-6 m
membership_derivation.antagonist_rule: monoarticular rule plus negative target sign in >=0.95 of effective states
membership_derivation.biarticular_rule: hip and knee effective-state fractions each >=0.8
membership_derivation.ambiguous_rule: any threshold-borderline, sign-inconsistent, or non-negligible other-joint case is excluded and reported; no name-based override

criteria: standard anatomical action is consistent with mechanically observed target-joint torque sign
multi-action or model-path disagreement is marked anatomically ambiguous
anatomical review never overrides the frozen mechanical rule
every included and excluded actuator receives a review label and reason

lmax: L2_LOG_WIDTH_ABOUT_FIXED_CENTER: center_i fixed; width_i(z)=width_i0*exp(z), changing lmin and lmax

operator_comparison_criteria_in_order: uses only inherited exact field family

all_factors: factor value zero is bitwise-equal to base targeted fields
only declared fields and members change
corresponding gainprm and biasprm entries remain exactly equal
structural topology, transmissions, sites, wraps, equalities and actuator_lengthrange remain unchanged
balance: rectus and hamstring family log-centers move equally and oppositely

v1_relation_decision_rules.hip_only_common_fpmax: SECONDARY_ONLY because prior evidence is magnitude-dominant and amended hip factor uses F0 rather than fpmax
v1_relation_decision_rules.knee_only_common_fpmax: SECONDARY_ONLY because prior evidence is magnitude-dominant and amended knee factor uses F0 rather than fpmax
v1_relation_decision_rules.biarticular_common_fpmax: REMOVE_FROM_PERSONALIZATION_FOCUSED_COHORT to avoid global fpmax scale confounding the amended within-family balance; a future explicit global-plus-balance decomposition would require a separate version
v1_relation_decision_rules.new_structural_factor_relation: REPLACED_BY_STRUCTURAL_FACTOR is a future personalization-focused design relationship, not physiological equivalence

allowed: single extremely small operator application at z=1e-8

readiness_rules.S1_STRUCTURAL_FACTOR_DEFINITION_AMENDED_: all four factors have deterministic mechanics-derived membership, complete operators, exact identity/synchronization/integrity PASS, and no unresolved semantic limitation
all four factors are deterministic and unit-valid, but range calibration or indirect physiological mapping limitations remain
readiness_rules.S1_STRUCTURAL_FACTOR_DEFINITION_AMENDMEN: one or more factor definitions remain unresolved or an operator/integrity invariant fails
